purpose: Machine-readable lifecycle states for README, FEATURE_STATUS.md and ROADMAP.md capability claims. No Phase 1 component is in the Pilot or Production state.

states.Design: Documented intent, register, wireframe or workflow with no runnable artifact or live effect.
states.Prototype: Runnable local demo using demo data or deterministic/simulated adapters; no external side effects.
states.Pilot: Restricted live operation with licensed providers, named operators, controlled real users and recorded evidence. Not present in Phase 1.
states.Production: Public live operation after security, reliability and compliance evidence plus explicit launch approval. Not present in Phase 1.

productionReadyRule: Every current component is not production-ready. The term is reserved for a component that has passed security, reliability and compliance evidence and has an approved launch record.

modules.name: Vintora Market
modules.scope: Age-gated demo catalogue, search, product detail, cart and checkout with five simulated safeguards.
modules.gate: No real catalogue rights, jurisdictional age assurance, PSP, fulfilment or live inventory.

modules.name: Vintora Trade
modules.scope: RFQ and wholesale screens with deterministic responses.
modules.gate: No contracts, credit engine, distributor KYB or live ordering.

modules.name: Vintora Sommelier
modules.scope: Deterministic pairing and safety note in the local UI and API.
modules.gate: No model calls, evaluation evidence, voice or multilingual production service.

modules.name: Vintora Assist
modules.scope: Confirmation-based concierge demo and cross-module routing.
modules.gate: No external actions, real personalization or tool execution.

modules.name: Vintora Studio
modules.scope: Rule-derived marketing draft UI with a human-release gate.
modules.gate: No generative model, live platform, ad spend or automatic publishing.

modules.name: Vintora Seller
modules.scope: Merchant screens with demo listings and inventory.
modules.gate: No real seller onboarding, payouts, tax or order fulfilment.

modules.name: Vintora Flow
modules.gate: No carrier integrations, customs/tax engine, cold-chain telemetry or delivery age check.

modules.name: Vintora Club
modules.gate: No billing, dunning, allocation or fulfilment.

modules.name: Vintora Vault
modules.gate: Custody, fractional title, secondary settlement and investor eligibility are blocked.

modules.name: Vintora Rewards
modules.gate: No ledger of record, partner integration or redemption.

internalLayers.name: Admin Panel

internalLayers.name: Global Payments
internalLayers.scope: Simulated payment adapter, 15-minute FX lock and idempotent checkout.
internalLayers.gate: No PSP, ledger of record, reconciliation or disputes.

internalLayers.name: AI Marketing Automation
internalLayers.scope: Draft-only evaluator, approval gate and audit events.
internalLayers.gate: No ad platform, spend, email send or automatic publishing.

internalLayers.name: Ultimate AI TechOps
internalLayers.scope: 24-agent advisory evaluator, allowlist, approval, isolation and safe-stop controls.
internalLayers.gate: No autonomous execution or timed kill-switch drill.

environments.name: Local runtime
environments.scope: Docker Compose or manual PostgreSQL fallback serving the API and storefront.

environments.name: Test profile
environments.scope: Boundary profile, shared domain tests, offline selftests and API smoke checks.

environments.name: Staging profile
environments.scope: Profile contract and startup self-test only.
environments.gate: No hosted staging environment, credentials or licensed providers.

environments.name: Production profile
environments.scope: Fail-closed guard and boundary configuration only.
environments.gate: Startup is rejected; no Production-state environment exists.

environments.name: Hosted CI
environments.scope: Workflow definitions for typechecks, tests, migrations, scanning and release.
environments.gate: No hosted CI result is attached to this local snapshot.

environments.scope: Expo placeholder showing canon facts and the Phase 3 target.
